objective.text: Assert dispatch to the intended named queue as well as the job type.

difficulty.rationale: Catch a routing regression that a job-type-only assertion misses.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A dispatch regression sends ImportRows to default instead of imports. The test already uses Queue::fake(). Which assertion directly detects this routing error?
